owner_directive: Issue #2304 owner decisions 2026-09-11 (option B): OSS keeps status quo (serve binds all interfaces, no login); multi-user Lab moves to private scistudio-enterprise with its own launch command built on create_app. OSS seam: (a) create_app accepts a replacement guard (default = today's loopback token on /api/webmcp/*); (b) startup/background lifespan hook with orderly teardown; (c) self-authenticating path registry honored by every guard, matched on the route path after root-path handling; (d) backend capability declaration read by a typed frontend accessor, default all off, no UI; (e) test-only fake guard plus a reusable guard contract suite. Declare the enterprise-relied surface provisional under ADR-052. Docs: new spec docs/specs/adr-055-identity-seam.md and ADR-055 amendment (status stays Proposed).
